CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `oee_metrics` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `machineId` int NOT NULL,
  `machineCode` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `timestamp` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `periodType` enum('HOUR', 'SHIFT', 'DAY', 'WEEK', 'MONTH') DEFAULT 'HOUR' NOT NULL,
  `availability` int NOT NULL,
  `performance` int NOT NULL,
  `quality` int NOT NULL,
  `oee` int NOT NULL,
  `plannedTime` int NOT NULL,
  `runTime` int NOT NULL,
  `idealCycleTime` int NOT NULL,
  `totalCount` int NOT NULL,
  `goodCount` int NOT NULL,
  `rejectCount` int NOT NULL,
  `calculatedBy` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'AUTO' NOT NULL,
  `notes` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_oee_machine` (`machineId`),
  INDEX `idx_oee_machine_code` (`machineCode`),
  INDEX `idx_oee_timestamp` (`timestamp`),
  INDEX `idx_oee_period` (`periodType`),
  INDEX `idx_oee_machine_time` (`machineId`, `timestamp`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `downtime_events` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `machineId` int NOT NULL,
  `machineCode` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `category` enum('planned', 'unplanned', 'breakdown', 'changeover', 'maintenance', 'other') NOT NULL,
  `reason` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `detailedReason` text,
  `startTime` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `endTime` timestamp,
  `duration` int,
  `detectionMethod` enum('MANUAL', 'AUTO', 'MQTT') DEFAULT 'MANUAL' NOT NULL,
  `reportedBy` int,
  `acknowledgedBy` int,
  `acknowledgedAt` timestamp,
  `resolution` text,
  `resolvedBy` int,
  `resolvedAt` timestamp,
  `affectedUnits` int DEFAULT 0,
  `estimatedCost` decimal(10, 2),
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_downtime_machine` (`machineId`),
  INDEX `idx_downtime_machine_code` (`machineCode`),
  INDEX `idx_downtime_category` (`category`),
  INDEX `idx_downtime_start` (`startTime`),
  INDEX `idx_downtime_end` (`endTime`),
  INDEX `idx_downtime_machine_time` (`machineId`, `startTime`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `oee_targets` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `machineId` int,
  `lineId` int,
  `targetOEE` int DEFAULT 8000 NOT NULL,
  `targetAvailability` int DEFAULT 9000 NOT NULL,
  `targetPerformance` int DEFAULT 9500 NOT NULL,
  `targetQuality` int DEFAULT 9900 NOT NULL,
  `alertThreshold` int DEFAULT 7000 NOT NULL,
  `criticalThreshold` int DEFAULT 6000 NOT NULL,
  `effectiveFrom` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `effectiveTo` timestamp,
  `isActive` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `setBy` int NOT NULL,
  `notes` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_oee_target_machine` (`machineId`),
  INDEX `idx_oee_target_line` (`lineId`),
  INDEX `idx_oee_target_active` (`isActive`),
  INDEX `idx_oee_target_effective` (`effectiveFrom`, `effectiveTo`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `machine_health_history` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `machineId` int NOT NULL,
  `machineCode` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `timestamp` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `healthScore` int NOT NULL,
  `oeeScore` int NOT NULL,
  `uptimeScore` int NOT NULL,
  `errorRateScore` int NOT NULL,
  `cycleTimeScore` int NOT NULL,
  `currentOEE` int,
  `uptimePercentage` int,
  `errorCount` int,
  `cycleTimeVariance` decimal(10, 2),
  `predictedFailureRisk` int,
  `recommendedMaintenanceDate` timestamp,
  `maintenanceUrgency` enum('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL'),
  `calculationMethod` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'WEIGHTED' NOT NULL,
  `notes` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_health_machine` (`machineId`),
  INDEX `idx_health_machine_code` (`machineCode`),
  INDEX `idx_health_timestamp` (`timestamp`),
  INDEX `idx_health_score` (`healthScore`),
  INDEX `idx_health_machine_time` (`machineId`, `timestamp`)
);
